newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize weaker in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize weaker in good volume.

text.p: Argentine cash maize slipped in good volume trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange midsession, with prices undermined by plentiful harvest supply and weaker prices abroad, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Bahia Blanca lost $2 to $111. Cash soybeans defied a lower Chicago and lost ground in moderate volume trading, pressured by harvest supply. Rosario spot soybeans slipped $2 to $288. May sunflower seed rose $2 to $222 in moderate volume, with demand from crushers to meet oil sales. Wheat was mixed in thin trade, losing $2 to $156 in Bahia Blanca with patchy demand from mills and exporters.
